verdict.rationale: RudderStack offers AI-generated insights via its MCP server and Slack-based Rudder AI agent — e.g., root cause analysis of delivery errors, duplicate event detection, tracking plan reviews, and natural-language Q&A with source citations — which fit the 'AI-generated insights inside the product' story, though these are aimed more at data/ops teams than a general end-user analytics insight feature. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, evidence of insights surfaced directly in the core product UI (not just Slack/MCP), and broader analytics-style suggestions (e.g., anomaly detection, trend suggestions) beyond pipeline/schema operations.
